title: Punchy STL Egg Fix
description: This resourcepack fixes a random issue I came across while making a modpack, in which the mod Punchy! has a bug where the new brown and blue egg types don't have proper throwing animations.
body: This resourcepack fixes a random issue I came across while making a modpack, in which the mod Punchy! has a bug where the new brown and blue egg types don't have proper throwing animations. Literally just add this texture pack into your resourcepack folder and it works right out of the box.
